title: Quietly Crumbly Korean Vegetable Namul
description: A crumbly and grassy Korean dish featuring blackcurrant jam, deep-fry-tod, and keto-friendly ingredients, perfect for a brunch mood. This namul dish is inspired by the flavors of Busan.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine grated zucchini and carrots.
In a small bowl, whisk together blackcurrant jam, sesame oil, and soy sauce.
Add the jam mixture to the bowl with the zucchini and carrots, and stir until well combined.
Stir in crushed deep-fry-tod, minced garlic, and chopped green onions.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add the namul mixture.
Cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until the mixture is lightly toasted and crumbly.
Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature.
Serve the namul at room temperature, garnished with additional chopped green onions if desired.
